anomalies.observed: The netlist contains two microcontroller parts, U1 (ATtiny13V-10S) and U4 (ATtiny45-20P), and every corresponding MCU pin is connected to the same net on both devices. For example, both U1.8 and U4.8 are on +5V, both U1.4 and U4.4 are on GND, and both U1.1 and U4.1 are on NET0012.
anomalies.expected: The specification describes an ATtiny-driven fan controller, implying a single ATtiny MCU. If the two packages were intended as alternate footprints, the design files should indicate that only one is populated or DNP; the netlist instead shows both MCUs as connected parts on every signal net.
anomalies.impact: If both MCUs are assembled, they will drive the same ISP/I2C/sensor/control lines simultaneously, causing output contention, undefined fan-control behavior, and possible damage to one or both MCUs.
